description: The player has woken in Aetheria (end of the prologue)
The player holds an Adventurers' Guild card
The player has met Brother Caspian and the orphans
The player passed the F→E trial
Grukk, Goblin Chief of Hollowpine, is dead; Whisperwood is Liberated
Old Hollis has trained the player as a Swordsman
The player has seen the mural of nine thrones (Mystery #1)
Early Act III: Lady Nocturne has replaced Mina at the guild counter
Lady Nocturne has been exposed; the real Mina is free
Lantern Night, Act V: Brother Caspian is revealed as the Red Prophet
The first demon army has taken Marrowgate (Act III beat); survivors reach Brindlewick
The player has seen the red ink in Marta's ledger
The player has resolved Teo's secret training
Teo has been brought home from the north road
The Sleeping Griffon is sheltering Marrowgate's refugees
Edric's sword has been reforged and given
The player knows about the mayor's secret road patrol
Guard Tomlin has taken the registration appraisal again
Captain Holt's gate count has been done
The player has delivered Widow Aster's candles
Fiddler Corwin has named the player's step
Joren's last contract has been finished
The player has made a lantern for Brindlewick's Lantern Night
Clue: the orphans' hymn tune is older than the orphanage
The player has sparred or watched in Pell's barn
The Inquisitor at the shrine has been dealt with
The medicine to the fugitive saint has been delivered or reported
The player has read Sister Ivy's letter to Pell
Eolande's overdue books are back on the shelf
The player has read the cookbook's margin notes
The Academy audit of the reading room is resolved
Clue: "Mina" asked for a cookbook by name
The player has talked to Brutus at dawn
Brutus's fifth attempt at the C trial is resolved
Hollis has told the story of the buried sword
Millbrook's Grey Sack has been opened or left sealed
Brindlewick's talent show has been judged
Rosie's warning in song has been acted on
Clue: the guild forms are signed in the wrong hand
The player has played Junior Receptionist Day with Tamsin
Clue: Bo's drawings show the red moon with buildings
Clue: Lark's adoption date is on a cult ledger
The player has carried Hugo's bread to the orphanage
The Crimson Wolves' second race is over
Old Sal has traded a Rainbow Koi scale for a story
Clue: a coin from the fog merchant is Valdrisian
The player has told Brannoc the name of their blade
